task.title: Conversation replies account for elapsed real-world time
task.source: User report: after saying goodnight and messaging the next day, characters sometimes still treated it as nighttime unless explicitly told good morning.

coreClaim: Conversation characters receive a compact, timezone-correct elapsed-time transition for meaningful gaps before a new user message, while short gaps, regenerations, impersonation, Roleplay, and Game retain their prior behavior.
rootCause: The conversation presence block supplied the current date and time, but visible ChatML history intentionally omitted each message's createdAt value. A previous night's exchange therefore appeared immediately adjacent to a new user turn, with no evidence that hours or a calendar day had passed.

inScope: Elapsed date and time formatting in the user's resolved timezone
Focused overnight, short-gap, and regeneration regression coverage
Design, implementation plan, and proof-ledger documentation
outOfScope: Adding timestamps to all prompt history
Storage schema, shared API, Rust, provider, or UI changes

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Normal Conversation sends after a gap of at least 30 minutes receive an explicit elapsed-time transition derived from stored message timestamps and the user's resolved timezone.
currentPathsOrFormats: Visible conversation messages carry persisted ISO createdAt values into prompt assembly.
userTimeZone or promptTimeZone controls local timestamp and calendar-day formatting.
Only a normal user-authored Conversation turn can append the transition to conversation_presence.
legacyPathsOrFormats: Missing, invalid, reversed, or sub-threshold timestamps safely skip the transition.
Regeneration and impersonation keep their existing prompt paths.
Existing stored conversation rows require no migration.
outOfScopeClaims: This PR does not make every historic timestamp visible to the model.
This PR does not change Roleplay or Game time behavior.
This PR does not guarantee a particular live model phrase in response to the transition.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Conversation prompt assembly knew the current clock but did not communicate the elapsed relationship between the previous visible exchange and a later user return.
contractLaneGate.consumer: Conversation model generation through the assembled conversation_presence block
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: A character responding in the present should know when a meaningful real-world gap or local calendar-day transition separates the new message from the preceding exchange.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Prompt assembly compares the latest visible user message with its visible predecessor, formats both in the resolved timezone, and appends compact elapsed-time facts only when the gap is at least 30 minutes.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: Engine prompt assembly owns conversation presence facts supplied to the model.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not require users to say good morning or add UI/storage/provider workarounds; the missing temporal relationship belongs in prompt assembly.
regressionProof: The overnight New York row asserts a 9 hour 30 minute gap and a crossed local calendar day.
The 10-minute row asserts no transition is added.
The regeneration row asserts no transition is added.
All 48 prompt-assembly tests and the full pnpm check baseline pass.

riskClaimMatrix.coreClaim: A later Conversation turn receives a truthful elapsed-time transition without changing excluded generation modes.
positiveRowsTested: 2026-06-21 23:30 to 2026-06-22 09:00 America/New_York produces 9 hours 30 minutes and local-day-crossed facts.
groundTruthFacts: Prompt assembly already owns the resolved conversation timezone and current presence block.
riskClaimMatrix.userActionCopy: No new user action or setting.
manualBlockers: Live stochastic model phrasing was not run; this does not block the deterministic prompt-contract claim.

positiveRows.claim: An overnight return supplies the elapsed relationship and local calendar-day transition.
positiveRows.evidence: The America/New_York regression row covers 2026-06-21 23:30 through 2026-06-22 09:00 and asserts a compact 9h 30m gap plus local-day-crossed guidance.

positiveRows.claim: The surrounding prompt-assembly contract remains green.
positiveRows.evidence: Eight prompt-assembly spec files passed with 48 tests.

positiveRows.claim: The repository shipping baseline remains green.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm check exited 0, including TypeScript, architecture, docs, agent workflow, frontend, and Rust workspace checks.

positiveRows.claim: The prompt change remains within the production bundle budget.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm perf:size passed with totalJs at 1727.8 KiB gzip against the 1728.0 KiB gzip budget.

contradictionRows.claim: A brief same-session pause should not add noisy time metadata.
contradictionRows.evidence: The 10-minute regression row asserts that no conversation transition is present.

contradictionRows.claim: Regenerating an existing reply should not be reinterpreted as a later user return.
contradictionRows.evidence: The regeneration regression row asserts that no conversation transition is present.

contradictionRows.claim: Roleplay and Game should not inherit this Conversation-only clock contract.
contradictionRows.evidence: The transition is constructed only inside the Conversation presence block path.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Old or malformed rows do not break prompt assembly.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Missing, invalid, reversed, or empty timestamps skip transition construction.
The transition appends to the existing conversation_presence block rather than replacing its current date, time, and timezone facts.

untestedRows: A live stochastic model reply was not generated on the user's character data.
Image-only user turns with empty text intentionally skip the transition and were not added as a separate regression row.

ownedFacts.description: Message persistence already owns the createdAt timestamps used by this fix.
ownedFacts.evidence: Visible messages supplied to prompt assembly expose createdAt without a storage or API change.

ownedFacts.description: Conversation presence is the mode-specific owner for present-time facts.
ownedFacts.evidence: The transition is appended by buildConversationPresenceBlock and is not added to Roleplay or Game prompt paths.

manualBlockers.reason: The core claim is the deterministic prompt contract. Running a live character turn would mutate user conversation data and still would not guarantee identical wording across models.

verification.baselineEvidence: The focused test first failed because no transition was present, then 7 focused tests, 66 assembleGenerationPrompt tests, pnpm perf:size, and the full pnpm check passed.

notes: No live model call was run; deterministic prompt construction and its negative controls are the proof boundary.
The Pi deployment will verify the exact merged image revision without mutating character conversation data.
